issues.issue: Did the RPD err in finding that the appellant's past bullying did not amount to persecution?
issues.applicant_position: Appellant alleges years of bullying amounting to persecution and argues cumulative acts entitle him to protection.
issues.respondent_position: RPD found discrimination did not threaten fundamental rights and was not persecution.
issues.result_text: Court did not decide if past events were persecution, focusing on forward-looking risk instead.

issues.issue: Does the appellant face a forward-looking risk of persecution or harm if returned to South Korea?
issues.applicant_position: Appellant argues he will face continued persecution as a high school student on return.
issues.respondent_position: RPD and court find no forward-looking risk; appellant will be an adult with no evidence of bullying continuing.
issues.result_text: Court finds no forward-looking risk of persecution or harm in South Korea.

issues.issue: Is the appellant entitled to education free from abuse and persecution upon return?
issues.applicant_position: Appellant claims right to education free from abuse and persecution as a high school student.
issues.respondent_position: Court finds appellant will have completed high school in Canada and be an adult; no evidence of adult bullying.
issues.result_text: Court disagrees; appellant will be adult with no evidence of bullying extending to adults.
